Turn your workout into a small adventure with a playlist as its soundtrack. Award yourself points for consistency and taking needed recovery days, rather than only for lifting more or exercising longer. For variety, invite a friend to invent a different theme each week. One week might be a space expedition; another could be a tour of favorite movie soundtracks. Check in afterward and celebrate the effort you both made.

If storytelling feels distracting, keep only the parts that help: a favorite song, a visible goal, or a friendly check-in. The aim is to make exercise something you look forward to, not another system you have to maintain. Rest when you need to, and stop if you feel pain or unwell. def sort_integers(values: list[int]) -> list[int]:
```python
    result = values.copy()
    result.sort()
    return result
```
This sorts in ascending order without modifying the supplied list. For instance, `[3, -1, 3]` becomes `[-1, 3, 3]` in the returned list. Empty lists and repeated values work as expected.

The sea had followed us for so long that I thought it knew our names.

Mother said the shore ahead was new to us, not empty. Smoke might mean strangers; silence might mean we had not yet learned to listen. I held the cord of our bundle while the elders watched the clouds.

When my feet touched the sand, a small creature vanished beneath a root. I wanted to run after it. Instead I looked back at the water, wondering which part of home had crossed with us.
1e3450b0dbff49cc6e10b2cad70d3300.b:
At dawn, the land was a dark line beneath the birds.

I asked Grandmother whether it had a name. “Someone may know one,” she said. “We have not learned it yet.”

Our bundles smelled of salt. Behind me, my brother slept against Mother's shoulder; ahead, the trees moved in a wind I could not feel. I carried the last shell from the shore we had left.

When we landed, I pressed it into my palm. The first thing I heard was not silence, but wings.
